info.title: HOTEL PMS SaaS platform contract (Phase 12)
info.description: Phase 12 SaaS and customer lifecycle operations. Platform staff permissions are evaluated outside tenant membership; platform billing is administrative and never writes the hotel ledger (journal, business_day, folio_charge). Tenant reads of platform objects are limited to the tenant's own subscription, entitlements, usage and administrative invoices.
